steps.name: Set closed
steps.do: Open **Set restaurant as closed**. Choose a restaurant, set a date range covering today, and enter a **Closed message** (e.g. **Manual test restaurant closed**).

steps.name: Map without include
steps.do: From the bottom nav, open **Map**. On **Specific Map**, set the date to today. In **Filter:**, enable **Restaurants**. Leave **Include closed restaurants** unchecked.
steps.expect: The closed restaurant marker is absent.

steps.name: Map with include
steps.do: With **Restaurants** still enabled, check **Include closed restaurants**, then click the closed restaurant marker.
steps.expect: The closed restaurant marker appears; its tooltip/banner shows the closed message.

steps.name: Closure override
steps.do: Open **Create restaurant closure override**. Choose the same restaurant, set a date range covering today, and enter a different **Closed message** (e.g. **Manual test override closed**).
steps.expect: Success that the restaurant closure override was saved.

steps.name: Map after override
steps.do: Return to **Map** on **Specific Map** today with **Restaurants** enabled and **Include closed restaurants** checked; click the restaurant marker.
steps.expect: Restaurant still closed; tooltip/banner shows the override **Closed message**.

steps.name: Opening schedule
steps.do: Open **Set restaurant opening schedule**. Choose the same restaurant, set a date range covering today, mark the applicable weekdays open, and submit.
steps.expect: Success that the restaurant opening schedule was saved.

steps.name: Map after opening schedule
steps.do: Return to **Map** on **Specific Map** today with **Restaurants** enabled and **Include closed restaurants** checked; click the restaurant marker.
steps.expect: Restaurant still closed; tooltip/banner still shows the override **Closed message**.
